description: Africa region manufacturing UX interaction logs for South Africa and Egypt factories. Covers workshop device operation UI (HMI), internal Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and employee feedback platform interactions.

fields.name: region
fields.description: Country region: South Africa or Egypt

fields.name: user_role
fields.description: User role (operator/supervisor/maintenance technician/quality inspector/plant manager/shift lead)

fields.name: retry_count
fields.description: Number of repeated operations by the user (重复操作次数)

fields.name: abandoned
fields.description: Whether the user abandoned the task (用户放弃)

fields.name: feedback_text
fields.description: Free-text feedback from the employee feedback platform (if any)

notes: Raw data contains known data quality issues (missing values, duplicate records, anomalous fields). All analysis is performed on a cleaned view; data quality issues are documented separately in the quarterly analysis report.
